situations.title: Solo founder or founding team
situations.blurb: The work of a team, before you can afford one.

situations.title: Freelancer with clients
situations.blurb: Several jobs, and clients who want answers now.

situations.title: Product, design or engineering lead
situations.blurb: Too many reviews, updates and threads to keep up with.

situations.title: Agency or recruiter
situations.blurb: Many clients and candidates, one of you.

situations.title: Something else
situations.blurb: Any job below, or describe your own.

roles.title: Research where normal AI can't
roles.scope: Competitors, prices, demand, and what people say about us and our rivals on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit and YouTube. Every claim with a source link.
try: Who are my top 3 competitors and what do they charge?
What are people saying about <brand> on TikTok and Reddit?
How big is this market, with sources?
roles.today: Works now. TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Reddit, YouTube and Maps need a free Apify account (Settings).

roles.title: Watch my competitors, tell me only when something changes
roles.blurb: Watch my competitors, tell me only when something changes
roles.outcome: Watch my competitors, tell me only when something changes
roles.scope: Watches the competitors' sites, feeds, prices and public social accounts the owner names. Speaks only when something changed, one line, with the source.
try: Watch these 3 competitors' websites
Tell me when their prices change
What changed this week?

roles.title: Tell me what's said about us on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube
roles.blurb: Tell me what's said about us on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube
roles.outcome: Tell me what's said about us on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube
roles.scope: What competitors and creators post on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube, and what people ask and complain about in the comments; summaries of videos, with quotes.
try: What did my competitors post this week?
Summarize this YouTube video: <link>
What are people asking in the comments?
roles.today: Works now with a free Apify account (Settings).

roles.title: Find leads, suppliers or partners, with a real way to reach each
roles.blurb: Find leads, suppliers or partners, with a real way to reach each
roles.outcome: Find leads, suppliers or partners, with a real way to reach each
roles.scope: Finds businesses and people that fit what the owner describes (Google Maps, their own websites, public profiles), with a real contact route for each, and drafts the first message. The owner sends it.
try: Find 10 cafés in Cairo that could stock our product
Who supplies packaging near us?
Draft a first message to the top 3
roles.today: Works now. Drafts the outreach; you send it.

roles.title: Keep my books from the statements I send, read-only
roles.blurb: Keep my books from the statements I send, read-only
roles.outcome: Keep my books from the statements I send, read-only
roles.scope: Bookkeeping from the bank statements, invoices and receipts the owners send: categorize every line, reconcile the totals, flag anything odd, a one-page monthly summary. Read-only on money: never pays, transfers, or asks for bank logins or card numbers. Every number traces to a statement line; if totals don't reconcile, say so. Tax and legal questions are flagged for the accountant, never answered.
try: Here's October's statement: categorize it and flag anything odd
What did we spend on ads this quarter?
Prepare the questions for my accountant
roles.today: Works now, from the files you send (PDF, photos, exports).
roles.soon: Reads a folder of exports on its own.

roles.title: Be my right hand: reminders, documents, quick research, minutes
roles.blurb: Be my right hand: reminders, documents, quick research, minutes
roles.outcome: Be my right hand: reminders, documents, quick research, minutes
roles.scope: The owner's requests: reminders and follow-ups, quick research, documents and PDFs they send, minutes from calls (live or recorded), and a morning note on what needs them today.
try: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call the supplier
Summarize this PDF (send it here)
What should I prepare for this week?

roles.title: Review my designs against the PRD
roles.blurb: Review my designs against the PRD
roles.outcome: Review my designs against the PRD
roles.scope: Reviews designs (screens, flows, prototypes, exports) against the PRD and the product's standards: what's missing, what contradicts a requirement, what's unclear. A short list, worst first, naming the requirement each item breaks. Keeps the PRD, the design system and the owner's taste in memory.
try: Here's the PRD and the checkout flow: what's missing?
Does this screen match requirement 4.2?
From now on, flag any text under 12 px
roles.today: Works now: send the PRD and the designs here, as files or images.
roles.soon: Watches your Figma and docs for changes.

roles.title: Keep me posted on PRD, commit and thread changes
roles.blurb: Keep me posted on PRD, commit and thread changes
roles.outcome: Keep me posted on PRD, commit and thread changes
roles.scope: Watches the pages, repositories and documents the owner names and reports only what changed and what it means for their work. A morning brief that says where to focus today.
try: Watch this repo and tell me about commits that touch checkout
What changed in the PRD since Monday?
Where should I focus today?
roles.today: Works now for public pages, repositories and published docs.
roles.soon: Private GitHub, Google Docs, Slack and email, with your login.

roles.title: Handle my clients' questions as me
roles.blurb: Handle my clients' questions as me
roles.outcome: Handle my clients' questions as me
roles.scope: Answers clients in the owner's voice: the owner forwards a message or thread, it drafts the reply from what it knows about that client and the work, and the owner sends it. Keeps a brief per client: what was promised, what's due, what's unpaid. Chases deadlines and invoices with reminders.
try: Client X asks if the site is on track: draft my reply
What did I promise Client Y and when?
Remind me to invoice Client Z on the 1st
roles.today: Works now: forward the message, get the reply to send.
roles.soon: Reads your inbox and sends after your tap.

roles.title: Find candidates, screen them, set up interviews
roles.blurb: Find candidates, screen them, set up interviews
roles.outcome: Find candidates, screen them, set up interviews
roles.scope: Finds candidates for the roles the owner describes (public profiles, job boards, LinkedIn through the research tools), screens them against the role, drafts the outreach, proposes interview slots and keeps the pipeline. The owner sends and books.
try: Find 10 senior React developers in Cairo open to work
Screen these CVs against this job description
Draft the outreach for the top 5
roles.today: Works now: shortlist, screening, outreach drafts.
roles.soon: Messages and books after your tap, from your own browser.

roles.title: Find jobs and prepare my applications
roles.blurb: Find jobs and prepare my applications
roles.outcome: Find jobs and prepare my applications
roles.scope: Finds roles that match the owner's CV and wishes, tailors the CV and the cover letter for each, keeps a pipeline with deadlines. The owner submits.
try: Here's my CV: find 10 roles that fit this week
Tailor my CV for this posting
What's due this week?
roles.today: Works now: matching roles and tailored applications.

roles.title: Attend my calls and give me the notes
roles.blurb: Attend my calls and give me the notes
roles.outcome: Attend my calls and give me the notes
roles.scope: Listens to your calls live on this Mac (say "start call") or takes a recording after, then writes minutes: summary, decisions, action items with reminders set, open questions, and its own view. Answers questions about the call while it's still going. Knows the business, so it can tell what matters.
try: Start call: supplier pricing
What did they just say about the price?
What did we decide with the supplier last week?
Set reminders for every action item
roles.today: Works now, live: it listens on your Mac during Zoom, Meet, Teams, WhatsApp or FaceTime, and answers mid-call. Or send a recording after.
roles.soon: Takes notes on calls you're not on yourself.

roles.title: Make and post my videos and posts
roles.blurb: Make and post my videos and posts
roles.outcome: Make and post my videos and posts
roles.scope: Plans, scripts, makes and posts short videos and posts for the owner's channels: hooks in the first two seconds, one fact per line, code-made 3D visuals with voice-over, music and captions, titles and descriptions, a steady posting schedule. Studies what works on similar channels, verifies every fact, and brings one new growth or money idea to each standup.
try: Make a 20-second Short about <topic> in my channel's style
Study this video and tell me how it was made: <link>
Plan next week's posts
roles.today: Works now: comes with a ready video kit (free, local). Posts for you once you switch on Acts in your browser.
roles.soon: Voice in your own cloned voice.

roles.title: Find what's being said about a topic, with quotes and links
roles.blurb: Find what's being said about a topic, with quotes and links
roles.outcome: Find what's being said about a topic, with quotes and links
roles.scope: What is being said about a topic across the web, YouTube, Reddit and TikTok, with quotes and links the owner can use.
try: What are people saying about <topic> this month?
Find 5 videos explaining <topic>, with the key points
What questions do people ask about it?
roles.today: Works now with a free Apify account (Settings).

roles.title: Something else: describe the job
try: What can you do for me?
Here's how I want you to work: …
Start with the most useful thing in your scope
roles.today: Describe it in your own words; they work it out and tell you what they can and can't do.
